scoring_justification: All target quantities are deterministic results of closed-form analytic formulas with given constants; the checker recomputes the exact expected values and compares, fulfilling T1.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference constants, threshold for PIMC width, and algorithm for recomputing reference values.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Constants and formula from paper's text; PIMC width bound of 15° is a conservative estimate from Fig. 8 to ensure any correct QHA distribution is considered narrower than PIMC.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Constants are hard-coded from paper; reference pdfs and expected energies are recomputed algorithmically in the prepare step; PIMC width bound is set to 15° based on visual inspection of Fig. 8 (FWHM ~30°, std ~12.5°, bound chosen safely above any plausible QHA std).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The algorithm and constants are faithful to the paper; the PIMC bound is a conservative threshold that does not affect the scientific conclusion (QHA < PIMC) and is derived from the paper's own figure.

output_contract.notes: The checker will discretise the angle distributions onto a common grid, compute similarity to hidden gold references, and verify structural relationships among the HA, QHA, and reference distributions. The specific criteria are held in the hidden grading specification.
